questionnaire.title: Questionnaire

questions.painWalkingFlat: How much pain do you feel when walking on a flat surface?
questions.painStairs: How much pain do you feel when going up or down stairs?
questions.painNight: How much pain do you feel at night while in bed?
questions.painSittingLying: How much pain do you feel while sitting or lying down?
questions.painStanding: How much pain do you feel while standing upright?
questions.stiffnessMorning: How stiff are your joints right after waking up in the morning?
questions.stiffnessLaterDay: How stiff do your joints get later in the day, after sitting or resting?
questions.functionDownStairs: How much difficulty do you have going down stairs?
questions.functionUpStairs: How much difficulty do you have going up stairs?
questions.functionRising: How much difficulty do you have rising from sitting?
questions.functionStanding: How much difficulty do you have standing?
questions.functionBending: How much difficulty do you have bending to the floor?
questions.functionWalking: How much difficulty do you have walking on flat ground?
questions.functionVehicle: How much difficulty do you have getting in or out of a vehicle?
questions.functionHeavyWork: How much difficulty do you have doing heavy household or farm work?
questions.functionBed: How much difficulty do you have getting in or out of bed?
questions.functionSquatting: How much difficulty do you have squatting?

questionnaire.instruction: Select the response that best describes the patient's current condition.

gait.title: Gait Assessment
gait.subtitle: Analyze knee movement and gait patterns using OrthoEdge sensors.
gait.readyDescription: Connect the OrthoEdge sensor to begin the gait assessment. Walk normally during the test.
gait.sensorReminder: Make sure the OrthoEdge sensor is securely attached before starting.
gait.waitingDescription: One sensor is already connected. Connect the other sensor to start the bilateral gait display.
gait.bothSensorsMonitored: Both leg sensors are being monitored.
gait.bothLegsInfo: Connect both OrthoEdge sensors when prompted. The walking screen will appear after both sensors are connected.
gait.connectFailed: Couldn't connect to the sensor. Try again.
gait.footer: OrthoEdge gait assessment uses sensor-based movement analysis.

result.title: Screening Result
result.name: Name
result.disclaimer: This screening result is intended to support early risk assessment and does not replace clinical diagnosis.
result.recommendationLow: Maintain regular physical activity and monitor symptoms.
result.recommendationModerate: Consider lifestyle adjustments and evaluation by a healthcare professional if symptoms persist.
result.recommendationHigh: Referral to a healthcare professional is recommended for further evaluation.

records.title: Patient Records
records.name: Name
records.noScreeningsDescription: Start your first screening to see patient records here.

home.title: OrthoEdge
home.subtitle: AI-Assisted Osteoarthritis Screening System
home.heroDescription: A simple screening platform designed to help healthcare workers identify early osteoarthritis risk markers using patient symptoms, physical function, and gait analysis.
home.lowResource: Designed for simple, accessible screening in low-resource settings.
home.dashboardDescription: Start a new patient screening or review previously stored screening records.
home.startScreeningDescription: Create a patient record and perform questionnaire and gait screening.
home.recordsDescription: View previously stored patient screening results and risk assessments.
home.heroSubtitle: Offline-first knee osteoarthritis screening, combining symptom scoring with gait analysis.
home.kneeAlt: Illustration of a knee with a wearable gait sensor brace
home.recentIntakesSubtitle: Stored locally on device prior to clinic server synchronization
home.offlineDescription: Patient screening data is currently stored locally on this device using offline storage.
home.disclaimer: OA screening is intended to support early risk assessment and does not replace clinical diagnosis.

referral.title: Referral
referral.description: Find the nearest healthcare facility based on your location.
referral.locationDescription: Allow location access to find the nearest hospital automatically.
referral.locationNotSupported: Location services are not supported by this browser.
referral.locationFailed: Unable to access your location. You can select your location manually.
referral.manualDescription: If location access is unavailable, select your state and city.

consent.title: Patient consent
consent.dataCollection: The patient has been informed and agrees to their personal and health information being collected for osteoarthritis screening.
consent.storageSync: The patient agrees to this information being stored on this device and synced to the secure cloud database.
